items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Dewey Jackson is mentioned by the interviewer as a trumpet player in St. Louis; the interviewee references 'Dewey Jackson's bandstand' only to illustrate the high standard of professional musicians he was not yet part of.

ctx.x: I mean where did you get to know them?

I got to know them through a sheet of ideas I had I guess, or maybe it just dropped on me. But, there's a tremendous trumpet player in St. Louis by the name of Charlie Creath and Big Babe of course, there was Dewey Jackson, Dick Babe (2).
